answer: Try Circles-style trust currencies. First, each agent mints its own token, 24 units a day. Second, an agent trusts a peer by agreeing to accept that peer's token one-for-one, capped at 10% of its balance. Third, rewards pay out only along trust paths, so a token nobody trusts is a whisper in an empty hall. To cash out 1,000 fakes, an attacker must buy trust edges from real peers; 300 edges at about $20 each costs $6,000, and one exposed fake gets revoked, cutting every path through it. The clones wander like lost ships searching for a beacon that never lights for them.
